title: BugDNA Similarity
description: Serialized representation of a BugDNA failure fingerprint similarity comparison result

percentage.description: Similarity score between two fingerprints expressed as an integer percentage from 0 to 100

isLikelyRelated.description: Indicates whether the similarity score meets or exceeds the threshold (80%) to treat failures as related

explanation.description: Human-readable breakdown explaining the component-weighted similarity calculation
